name: Game Shakers
description: A live-action sitcom about two 12-year-old girls who start a multi-million-dollar gaming company and take on rap superstar Double G as a business partner.

videos.title: Sky Whale
videos.overview: After creating the game app Sky Whale for their science project, which grown out to the most popular game app of the year, Babe and Kenzie start gaming company Game Shakers with their friend Hudson in Brooklyn. But they used Double G's music in the game. He sues them all he has been owed. To make things right, Babe and Kenzie take him on as business partner and hire his son Triple G as a game consultant.

videos.title: Sky Whale (2)
videos.overview: After creating the game app Sky Whale for their science project, which grown out to the most popular game app of the year, Babe and Kenzie start gaming company Game Shakers with their friend Hudson in Brooklyn. But they used Double G's music in the game. He sues them all he has been owed. To make things right, Babe and Kenzie take him on as business partner and hire his son Triple G as a game consultant.

videos.title: Lost Jacket, Falling Pigeons
videos.overview: Babe buys herself a fancy new jacket after Dub gives the girls bonuses for Sky Whale's success; a flock of pigeons takes up residence in Game Shakers.

videos.title: Dirty Blob
videos.overview: Double G gives the girls a bonus for Sky Whale's amazing success, and Babe buys a jacket from the money. But a flock of pigeons suddenly takes up residence in Game Shakers.

videos.title: MeGo the Freakish Robot
videos.overview: The gang must design a game based on a robot, but problems arise when the robot malfunctions after a bromance goes bad.

videos.title: Tiny Pickles
videos.overview: Babe and Kenzie's new game is ready, but Dub promises the world another game on a crazy dream he had.

videos.title: Scared Tripless
videos.overview: Double G asks Babe and Kenzie to help him scare Triple G on Halloween, but the girls decide to reveal his plan to Triple G.

videos.title: Trip Steals the Jet
videos.overview: Feeling pressure to fit in with Trip's rich friends, Babe convinces Trip to borrow Dub's jet for the night.

videos.title: Lost on the Subway
videos.overview: The Game Shakers take the subway to a boxing game pitch, but forget the gloves and send Trip and Hudson back for them.

videos.title: You Bet Your Bunny
videos.overview: The Game Shakers host a tournament to promote a new Sky Whale update; Double G bets Bunny, thinking Babe will beat one of her classmates.

videos.title: A Reggae Potato Christmas
videos.overview: When the Game Shakers visit Double G on the set of his Christmas special, an accident during the opening number forces them to finish the show without him.

videos.title: Poison Pie
videos.overview: Babe and Kenzie get noise complaints from the neighbor, so they bake him a pie to make amends. After the pie sends the neighbor to the hospital, Double G and Triple G go undercover to clear the girls' names.

videos.title: Party Crashers
videos.overview: Babe and Kenzie's plans to hang with Mason are ruined when Bunny and Ruthless crash a birthday party; Dub uses Hudson to make Trip jealous when Trip chooses work over hanging out with him.

videos.title: A Job for Jimbo
videos.overview: The Game Shakers work to finish creating a new ocean pollution game; Dub hopes to score a duet with a famous singer, so he makes the company hire her step-grandson.

videos.title: Shark Explosion
videos.overview: Triple G's mom Jackie invites the Game Shakers on her yacht to see fireworks. But she and Double G have doubled booked the yacht, causing Dub to compete with her for the kids' affection.

videos.title: Nasty Goats
videos.overview: When the gang discovers a hacker put their newest game on an illegal website, they track him down in Alaska. With the help of Double G, they strike a deal with the hacker to take down their game.

videos.title: Babe's Fake Disease
videos.overview: Kenzie invites an uninterested Babe to her coding club; Babe swoons when she meets a member of Kenzie's coding club. Meanwhile, an aging app predicts that Trip will go bald.

videos.title: The Diss Track
videos.overview: When a rival rapper releases a track about Double G, the Game Shakers convince him to release a response track.

videos.title: Revenge at Tech Fest: Part 1
videos.overview: The Game Shakers have the Girls Who Code help them when an old rival of Double G's returns for revenge.

videos.title: Revenge at Tech Fest: Part 2
videos.overview: The Game Shakers have the Girls Who Code help them when an old rival of Double G's returns for revenge.

videos.title: Secret Level
videos.overview: Hudson releases false information about a secret level in a Game Shakers' game; Babe goes on a date with Mason Kendal.

videos.title: Babe's Bench
videos.overview: Babe blows the entire Game Shakers ad budget on a high-tech bus bench, only to find out the bench is a magnet for low-life's and weirdos.

videos.title: Wing Suits & Rocket Boots
videos.overview: The Game Shakers set Hudson up with a let's play account to help promote their games, but things quickly get out of hand when Hudson puts on Dub's rocket boots for fun.

videos.title: Game Shippers
videos.overview: To settle a dispute over whether Freddie liked Carly or Sam from ``iCarly'' more, the Game Shakers track down Nathan Kress himself and try to get the answer out of him by any means necessary.

videos.title: The One With the Coffee Shop
videos.overview: After being snubbed in an online story about Game Shakers and a fight with Babe, Kenzie takes a job as a coffee shop waitress.

videos.title: The Trip Trap
videos.overview: Babe and Kenzie are suspicious of Trip's new fame-hungry girlfriend and are determined to find out if she's using him to get closer to Double G.

videos.title: The Switch
videos.overview: When Dub and the Game Shakers swap Bunny for Hudson, the Game Shakers quickly regret it and have to figure out how to get Hudson back.

videos.title: Dancing Kids, Flying Pig
videos.overview: In order to finish their new dance game on time, The Game Shakers have to wear a motion capture suit and dance their way through the next 48 hours.

videos.title: Babe Gets Crushed
videos.overview: After Trip fervently asks Babe for some Romantic advise for his friend 'Chuck', she comes to the suspicion that Trip is having a crush on her and tries everything to avoid an embarrassing situation at work.

videos.title: Babe Loves Danger
videos.overview: Babe tries to plan the perfect date when she learns that Henry Hart is coming to New York to visit her.

videos.title: Lumples
videos.overview: A toy company hires the gang to make a game on a toy that they are not allowed to see.

videos.title: Subway Girl
videos.overview: When a video of Babe dancing to Dub's new music video goes viral, Dub challenges Babe to a dance battle to prove he is the better dancer.

videos.title: SNACKPOT!
videos.overview: Hudson and Trip open a vending machine that dispenses snacks at random on the subway; Dub quickly becomes obsessed with the device.

videos.title: Babe & the Boys
videos.overview: Kenzie's dating app causes huge problems for Babe.

videos.title: Escape From Utah!
videos.overview: The girls go to Utah to rescue Trip after Dub sends him to Captive Meadows, a center for boys with bad behavior.

videos.title: Super Ugly Head
videos.overview: Kenzie is torn whether to tell on Dub after she sees him tear down his own statue.

videos.title: Snoop Therapy
videos.overview: The Game Shakers haven't been getting along. Dub recommends they see his office therapist: Snoop Dogg. Special Guest Star: Snoop Dogg

videos.title: Hot Bananas
videos.overview: Trip becomes depressed after losing a big video game battle to a 7-year-old.

videos.title: Flavor City
videos.overview: Dub gets tickets to a VIP performance of the hottest musical of all time - Flavor City.

videos.title: Wet Willy's Wild Water Park
videos.overview: The Game Shakers go to Wet Willy's Wild Water Park on its last day to try and break the speed record on the extremely dangerous water slide, the Big Ripper.

videos.title: Demolition Dollhouse
videos.overview: Babe and Kenzie try to locate a cute boy who waved to Kenzie on the subway while Hudson and Trip become obsessed with a model doll house. Special Guest Star: Snoop Dogg

videos.title: Hungry Hungry Hypno
videos.overview: Kenzie is hypnotized into being very, very hungry after the Game Shakers take her to see a hypnotist for her birthday.

videos.title: Breaking Bad News
videos.overview: The Game Shakers have to figure out how to break the news to Dub that they broke his expensive new television.

videos.title: Bug Tussle
videos.overview: After Dub goes to Vegas and leaves Trip behind, the Game Shakers take Trip to Dub's awesome apartment to show him a good time.

videos.title: Why Tonya
videos.overview: The Game Shakers are approached by a fan who demands they make changes to one of their games.

videos.title: Boy Band Cat Nose
videos.overview: Dub recommends Kenzie see an eccentric pet plastic surgeon in order to fix her cat's loud nose holes. Meanwhile, Trip tries to get Hudson into a Boy Band.

videos.title: He's Back
videos.overview: Babe has to make a choice when multiple guys from her past want to date her. Meanwhile, Trip and Hudson have to buy a famous watch for Dub. Guest Stars: Snoop Dogg and Jace Norman
